variants.name: Line chart
variants.desc: A line draws across a chart while its eyes trace it.

variants.name: Bars
variants.desc: Bars rise and fall as it compares the numbers.

variants.name: Glasses
variants.desc: Puts on glasses and leans in to study, with a glint.

variants.name: Pie
variants.desc: A pie chart turns and one slice pops out.

variants.name: Scatter
variants.desc: Points land on a chart, then a trend line cuts through.
